'''Gloom Hill''' is a plateau located in the [[Scarlet Enclave]] to the west of [[Havenshire]]. [[Noxious Pass|A cave]] leads to the [[Noxious Glade]] in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]], though it has been caved in. Regardless, nerubians burrow through the pass to attempt to attack the Enclave, where they are met with Scarlet defenders.
